claims.claim: **Create a dedicated host account and accept the hosting agreement.** Start from the official [Vast host setup page](https://cloud.vast.ai/host/setup/), then see [Host Account and Agreement](/host/account-hosting-agreement) if the account flow gets stuck. Before using keys or automation, review [Host Account Security](/host/account-security-for-hosts).

claims.claim: **Prepare the machine.** Set up Ubuntu, drivers, and BIOS with [Hardware Prep](/host/hardware-prep), disks with [Storage Setup](/host/storage-setup), and port forwarding with [Network & Ports](/host/network-ports).

claims.claim: **Install the Vast host software with the Host Installer Wizard (TUI).** Copy the current command from the official [Vast host setup page](https://cloud.vast.ai/host/setup/), then use [Installing Host Software](/host/installing-host-software#host-installer-wizard) to understand the install flow. Running over SSH only? Use the [Headless Install Path](/host/headless-install).
